title: Carprin Deatharn cycle
summary: Break Carprin's guard protection and follow the named sequence deeper into the crypt.
overview: Break Carprin's guard protection and follow the named sequence deeper into the crypt.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Defeat all three guards before killing Carprin; killing him first brings out a replacement with another guard set.
Rebuild threat after Carprin's recurring hate wipes.
Prevent deaths during Avhi Escron: fallen players cause more reanimated reavers to appear.
Prepare for each named successor and its accompanying enemies before advancing.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
